values: Compare the two supplied exports and isolate records that cannot both be correct.
AIRS ledger rows with no same-date Leonteq execution
The exports are not directly reconcilable: several 4-Aug records have opposing direction or materially different quantities.
Filter Comparison by Status = Quantity differs to review the confirmed conflicts.
Filter Status = No same-date transaction before assuming a missing trade; the AIRS ledger may be a position snapshot, not an execution report.
Use Leonteq execution and AIRS ledger to check identifiers, price and account context with the originating broker/custodian.
Resolve the source type and account scope before changing any positions in the application.
'A' and 'V' are retained as supplied. The workbook interprets A as Buy and V as Sell only for same-date comparison; confirm this with the ledger producer.
